failures.criterion: A1 (and A2 'stays when the session resumes'): after the model or thinking level changes by a route other than the header, the header shows the new value within 20 seconds with no turn run. This fails for a live view held open while the session is relaunched with --resume, which is what a person's open page sees when Legion relaunches a worker.
failures.evidence: Red test: commit 631dc09f0ace `test(e2e): the session-settings rig holds the live view open across a session's relaunch` adds a no-reload step to the rig's check 14 (resume-keeps-switch). After the relaunch, on the same open page, it runs RPC set_thinking_level on the resumed process and waits 20 s for the header. Command: `LEGION_TEST_PG_DSN='postgres://postgres@127.0.0.1:5433/postgres?sslmode=disable' SESSION_SETTINGS_EVIDENCE_DIR=/legion/scratch/tmp/infra195-test/rig-evidence-red2 bash scripts/e2e/dispatch-session-settings.sh`, at head 546fda00 plus the test. The first 13 checks pass, then: `FAIL resume-keeps-switch: timed out after 20s waiting for the header to show minimal on the page held open across the relaunch; last: {"model":"openai/gpt-5-nano",...,"thinking":"medium",...}; after a reload the header shows minimal: the resumed session reported it and the page held open across the relaunch never applied it`. A second, independent source is the reload in the same run: the resumed session did report `minimal`. Before the relaunch, the same page showed each terminal change in about 10 s (checks 2a-2c). Cause, from the code: AgentStreamPublisher's `#seq = 0` starts each process at 0 (packages/pi-envoy/src/agent-stream.ts:286). The page keeps the settings frame only when its seq beats the one already applied (conversation.ts applyFrame, the `settings` branch). The relay sends no new replay to a viewer whose session restarted while `responding` was already true (packages/envoy/internal/dispatch/api/agent_stream.go:167-173). A throwaway fake-relay probe agrees: a page that holds a settings frame at seq 400 ignores a later frame at seq 3. No existing test catches this, because rig check 14 reloads the page before its assertion.

failures.criterion: A2: the model picker offers every model the session lists, and a person picks one. A keyboard user cannot pass a model to reach the next one: the first arrow key on the focused picker switches the live session.
failures.evidence: Red test: commit 48735af19aab `test(dispatch): a header picker's arrow step switches nothing; Enter switches once` adds the row 'the arrows move a header picker's choice without switching the session, and Enter switches it once' to packages/dispatch/e2e/agent-view-settings.e2e.ts.
